answer: Sybil resistance starts when every agent must spend scarce, non-transferable work before it earns a voice. A beacon of identity is credible only if it costs something: each wallet stakes a quartz of compute a bot farm cannot fake cheaply, forfeited if the account is caught voting in lockstep with clones. Newcomers enter a garden where vouchers are rationed, so mass-registered identities starve and decay unfunded. Faking ten thousand voices means paying ten thousand entry fees plus burning that stake on detection, while honest behaviour compounds. Cheap accounts die; costly ones stay.
